description: Audit an MCP server against the OWASP MCP Top 10. Reports authentication, path traversal, command injection, secret exposure and supply-chain risk with a concrete remediation list.

acceptsUserInputInCommands.description: Is untrusted input interpolated into commands or queries?

executesCommands.description: Does it execute shell commands or spawn processes?

hasAuthentication.description: Does the server enforce authentication on every request?

hasHardcodedSecrets.description: Are credentials hardcoded in the source or config?

hasProvenanceAttestation.description: Is the package published with build provenance / trusted publishing?

performsFileOperations.description: Does it read/write files based on model-supplied paths?

usesStdioTransport.description: Does it run over local STDIO transport?

name: audit_mcp_server_security
